name: State Machine Module System with LTL Property Preservation

mentions.name: State Machine Module System with LTL Property Preservation
mentions.description: This project defines a module system for state machines with scoping and an ownership type system, along with attendant theorems to carry proofs of LTL properties about individual parts forward after composition.
